executive.bottom_line: Three advisers were compared for the global macro mandate: Ridgeview reports $12.40B regulatory AUM, Harbor $4.85B and Northfield $1.92B [S1][S2][S3]. None reports an Item 11 disciplinary disclosure [S1][S2][S3]. Harbor has 2 of 9 private funds with no administrator named and Northfield reports custody through a related person, so both carry medium flags [S2][S3]. Weighted 13F overlap between Ridgeview and Harbor is 18.4% for the 2026-06-30 period [S6]; Northfield is not in the diligence catalog, so it has no 13F, consistency or events evidence. This is an evidence comparison, not a ranking.

blocks.title: How to read this
blocks.text: Overlap uses same-period, complete SEC Form 13F reported long positions. It excludes shorts, cash, many non-US securities and confidential-treatment holdings, and does not imply manager intent [S6]. 13F is firm-level and lagged; it is not the mandate's portfolio.
